schema_version: v0 — skill-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: Frictionless capture of HISTORICAL or SHORT-TERM OPERATIONAL notes — what was true at a moment, kept because forgetting it would cost something soon. Writes a note record to CairnCommons/notes/.
why: Capture must be near-zero friction or thoughts are lost between the moment they surface and the moment there's time to act on them. A note is a holding pen — non-terminal, un-cast, un-proved — so it costs almost nothing to make and carries no false weight. It later gets picked up by /intent if it grows into work.
how_it_learns: Barely, and honestly so: /note is a thin capture utility; its only feedback is friction — notes that never get picked up signal format drag, so simplify. It accrues no gate-confidence of its own. Doesn't meaningfully learn, because thin. CORRECTED 2026-08-04, same day: this skill is not a cairn.skill_block tenant, and the first version of this sentence concluded from that it was UNMEASURABLE. That was wrong, and wrong in the direction that matters — the firings were on disk the whole time, as records in CairnCommons/notes/. Not being a seam tenant means it is not JUDGED at a door; it never meant it was not counted. The count is 3 (see counted_by), and the disuse clause has had a number available to it since before it was written.
traces_to: Law 5 (a thought worth keeping gets an address)
the fluid-middle stance — non-terminal capture (learning-loop keystone)
owner: the skills charter gates writes; Akien ratifies changes (signature gate)

counted_by.address_in_words: CairnCommons/notes/*.json, records conforming to that store's declared template
counted_by.what_it_counts: records carrying the store template's required fields (id, date, author, text) — which is what a /note firing produces. Measured 2026-08-04: 3 of 25 records conform. The other 22 are held design documents written straight into the store with arbitrary hand-authored shapes, and counting them as /note firings would be a count that is green for the wrong reason.
counted_by.THE_RED_THIS_MEASUREMENT_EXPOSED: the notes store charter says 'the single commons emit chokepoint validates every record against the template below (Law 6)'. Twenty-two of twenty-five records prove it does not. Either the chokepoint is not wired for this store or it is being bypassed — filed as a trouble, not fixed here.
counted_by.why_not_the_seam: the note record IS the firing artifact, and it is durable commons rather than instance-space — a better home than a berth that dies with the box. But this is the one skill where a seam door would ALSO be defensible, because the record is only note-shaped by convention today. If the chokepoint red gets fixed by enforcement, this stays; if it gets fixed by moving /note onto the seam, this declaration is what gets deleted.
counted_by.the_number_is_the_disuse_clause: 3 firings, and the narrowing that produced the clause happened the same day the count was first taken. So the clock on 'could wind up being excised through disuse' starts 2026-08-04 with a baseline of 3, and a disuse call made before that clock has run is a call made on no evidence.

proof: skill node → done only when cairnmap recompiles green (derivation gate). IOU until cairnmap exists — tracked in proofs/.
provenance: converged in the founding design conversation (MAP.md 'Workflow + starting skills', 2026-07-15) — 'anything in discussion not tracked elsewhere goes to notes'.
narrowed_2026_08_04: Akien, ruling the split when skill:/idea was built: 'slash note becomes more for historical or short term operational notes. could wind up being excised through disuse.' Before this, this charter's own why said a note 'later gets picked up by /intent if it grows into work' — which is now /idea's job, and /intent cites the idea in its from_idea field. What is left here is the short-half-life capture: the operational fact, the state of a thing at a moment. THE DISUSE CLAUSE IS NOT A DEPRECATION: this skill is not marked dying, it is marked COUNTABLE — and it can only be excised on measured disuse, never on an impression of it. A skill that is dying and a skill that was never wired look identical in an uncounted system.
